lines.en: label beachwars2:
scene sky
When we finally make it to the beach, Imani quickly takes roll call to see which of us are still missing since some of the girls weren’t able to make it onto the bus on time.
lines.zh: 我们终于到了海滩,Imani 赶紧点了名,看看还有谁没到,因为有些女生没能准时上巴士。

lines.en: Thankfully, one of the girls who is currently missing is Wakana.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地,目前还没到的人里有 Wakana。

lines.en: So, at the very least, I’ll remain alive until she gets here and follows through on her apparent need to kill me for what I will ultimately simplify as writer’s block in order to avoid a more depressing explanation.
lines.zh: 她显然想杀了我,至于原因,我最终会把它简化为『写作瓶颈』,好避开更让人沮丧的解释。所以至少,在她赶来动手之前,我还能活着。

lines.en: It’s not that I didn’t {i}want{/i} to write something. I just couldn’t.
lines.zh: 不是我不{i}想{/i}写东西。是我写不出来。

lines.en: You see, in my opinion, it’s fine for characters to grow or develop.
lines.zh: 你看,在我看来,角色有所成长、有所发展是没问题的。

lines.en: It’s {i}fine{/i} for people to look back on things they’ve done in the past and learn to move forward without being dragged down by them.
lines.zh: 人回头看自己过去做过的事、学会不被它们拖着往下走,也是{i}没问题{/i}的。

lines.en: But it’s also fine to {i}not{/i} do that.
lines.zh: 但{i}不{/i}那么做也没问题。

lines.en: It’s fine to remain the same piece of shit you have always been because you know that moving forward and growing should be for those of us who {i}don’t{/i} hide our worries in the fleshy depths of developing bodies.
lines.zh: 继续当你一直以来的那个烂人也没问题,因为你清楚,前进和成长应该属于我们这些{i}不会{/i}把自己的烦恼藏进少女肉体深处的人。

lines.en: It is {i}fine{/i} to spend these hateful summer days entranced by the same things you once thought that you don’t want to think anymore because you have learned how to think of other things to think about.
lines.zh: 在这些可恨的夏日里,继续被同一件你曾以为自己再也不愿去想的东西迷住,也{i}没问题{/i}——因为你已经学会了去想些别的东西来想。

lines.en: And you’re a good guy. You are. But you’re also bad. You’re evil. And your mind is pulling you in so many directions that figuring out which one to go in becomes impossible.
lines.zh: 而你是个好人。你是。可你也坏。你很邪恶。而你的脑子正把你往那么多方向上拉,以至于要弄清该往哪儿走变得不可能。

lines.en: You become the rope.
lines.zh: 你成了那根绳子。

lines.en: And when you snap, everyone loses.
lines.zh: 而当你绷断的时候,所有人都输。

lines.en: It’s hard to breathe again.
lines.zh: 又呼吸困难了。

lines.en: And so, {i}so{/i} hot.
lines.zh: 而且,好热。{i}太{/i}热了。

lines.en: scene beachwarshello1
Everyone eventually shows up and I don’t have to think anymore.
lines.zh: 最后所有人都到齐了,我也不用再想了。

lines.en: The first point goes to me.
lines.zh: 第一分归我。

lines.en: : Alright, bitches and hoes! And also Molly!
lines.zh: : 好了,婊子们和骚货们!还有 Molly!

lines.en: : Why do you always- oh. Wait. I think it was good that I was excluded this time. Carry on.
lines.zh: : 你为什么每次都——哦。等等。我觉得这次被排除在外反而是好事。继续。

lines.en: : Now that we’ve all gathered here, it’s time to begin the third annual Dorm Wars! Kind of!
lines.zh: : 既然大家都聚齐了,是时候开始第三届宿舍大战了!算是吧!

lines.en: : Kind of?
lines.zh: : 算是吧?

lines.en: : Seeing as we didn’t want our entire beach trip to be overly-competitive, Uta and I have decided that the best way to ensure at least {i}some{/i} level of relaxation is to push back the first contest until later tonight.
lines.zh: : 鉴于我们不想让整趟海滩之旅都过于竞技化,Uta 和我决定,保证大家至少能放松{i}一点{/i}的最好办法,就是把第一场比赛推迟到今晚。

lines.en: : With the one notable exception being the brand new, confusing two-part contest Makoto came up with. {i}That{/i} will begin as soon as she’s done explaining the rules. So maybe sometime next week if we’re lucky.
lines.zh: : 唯一值得一提的例外,是 Makoto 想出的那个全新的、令人困惑的两段式比赛。她一解释完规则就开始。所以运气好的话说不定下周。

lines.en: scene beachwarshello2
: It’s really not as confusing as Uta is making it sound. The whole idea is to just prevent Sensei from being touched which, let’s face it...pretty much all of you do every single day anyway.
lines.zh: : 真没 Uta 说得那么难懂。整个思路就是不让 Sensei 被碰到,而说实话……你们基本上每天都在干这事。

lines.en: : Additionally, it will not begin as soon as my explanation ends as we should give our teams at least a few minutes to prepare first.
lines.zh: : 另外,也不会在我解释完就立刻开始,我们总该给各队至少几分钟准备。

lines.en: scene beachwarshello3
: Regardless, since all of you spend so much time fighting over Sensei, I thought...why not make a competition out of it?
lines.zh: : 总之,既然你们都花那么多时间抢 Sensei,我就想……何不干脆把它变成一场比赛?

lines.en: : Especially since the girls of the first floor have way more experience roadblocking physical contact with Sensei than the ones on the floor above us.
lines.zh: : 尤其是,一楼的女生在阻碍与 Sensei 发生肢体接触这方面,可比楼上那层的经验丰富多了。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be so sure about that, Makoto. If anybody’s good at roadblocking physical contact, it’s good ole Room #7. That’s basically our whole thing.
lines.zh: : 这我可不敢苟同,Makoto。要说谁最擅长阻断肢体接触,那还得是我们亲爱的 7 号房。这基本就是我们的看家本领。

lines.en: scene beachwarshello4
: Is it? I could have sworn your room’s thing was just being short and annoying.
lines.zh: : 是吗?我怎么记得你们房的本事就只是个子矮又烦人。

lines.en: : You think I’m annoying?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我烦人?

lines.en: : Well, when you go calling the contest I spent a whole night coming up with “weird and confusing,” it’s kind of hard to not get annoyed-
lines.zh: : 嗯,当你把我花了一整晚想出来的比赛叫成『又怪又难懂』的时候,不烦才怪-

lines.en: : Makoto. Rules, please. I would like to go relax now.
lines.zh: : Makoto。说规则,拜托。我现在想去放松了。

lines.en: : And I would like to continue not giving a shit, but in a slightly more informed way.
lines.zh: : 而我想继续不在乎,只不过想在不在乎的同时多懂一点。

lines.en: scene beachwarshello5
: Fine. The simplest way of putting it is that Noriko and Maya have to try and hug Sensei. And it’s up to Yumi and Tsuneyo to make sure that doesn’t happen.
lines.zh: : 好。最简单的说法就是:Noriko 和 Maya 要试着去抱 Sensei。而 Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 负责确保这事不会发生。

lines.en: : If it does, the team that made the hug gets two points and the team that doesn’t gets nothing.
lines.zh: : 如果她们成功了,抱到的那队得两分,没抱到的那队一分也没有。

lines.en: : What if, in some crazy turn of events, Maya and I manage to hug Sensei at the exact same time and it’s like, some big emotional climax thing?
lines.zh: : 那万一,在某个疯狂的转折里,Maya 和我同一时刻抱住了 Sensei,搞得像什么盛大的情感高潮呢?

lines.en: : Then I burst into flames and all three of us die. The end.
lines.zh: : 那我就自燃,我们三个一起死。结束。

lines.en: : In the event of Maya, Noriko, {i}and{/i} Sensei dying, the points will simply cancel out.
lines.zh: : 若发生 Maya、Noriko {i}和{/i} Sensei 死亡的情况,分数直接抵消。

lines.en: : Can we please be a little more concerned about my make-believe death?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能稍微关心一下我那想象中的死亡?

lines.en: : Can we please be a little more concerned about people other than me hugging my uncle?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能稍微关心一下,除了我以外的人抱我叔叔这件事?

lines.en: : No and no. Any other questions?
lines.zh: : 不行,也不行。还有别的问题吗?

lines.en: scene beachwarshello6
: Yeah. Is it too late to switch classes?
lines.zh: : 有。现在转班还来得及吗?

lines.en: : You’ll have to ask Miss Watabe when she gets here.
lines.zh: : 这个你得等 Watabe 老师来了问她。

lines.en: : How the fuck am I supposed to do that when I’ve gotta apparently spend the whole ass weekend beating the shit out of Pinkie?
lines.zh: : 我他妈要怎么问啊,我显然得花一整个周末把 Pinkie 揍个半死!

lines.en: : Please don’t {i}beat{/i} anyone. And it’s not the whole weekend. It’s just until one of them succeeds in hugging him.
lines.zh: : 别{i}揍{/i}任何人。而且也不是一整个周末。只是持续到她们中有一个成功抱到他为止。

lines.en: : Well then Ponytail better hurry the fuck up because if I need to babysit our pervert teacher for the next two nights, I’m just going to drown myself.
lines.zh: : 那 Ponytail 最好他妈快点,因为要是接下来两晚我都得给我们这位变态老师当保姆,我干脆把自己淹死算了。

lines.en: : You know, I’m really happy you’re finally participating, but I do wish you’d be a little happier about it.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,你终于肯参加了我真的很高兴,但我确实希望你对此能开心一点。

lines.en: scene beachwarshello7
: And I wish you didn’t offer me half of your next paycheck if I can win us this stupid fucking contest. Offer was too good to pass up.
lines.zh: : 而我还希望你没说过,要是我能帮咱们赢下这场该死的比赛,就把你下个月工资的一半给我。那条件太诱人了,根本没法拒绝。

lines.en: : If there are no further questions, I’ll leave the rest of today’s pre-war explanation and scheduling talk up to Uta.
lines.zh: : 如果没有别的问题,今天的赛前说明和赛程安排就交给 Uta 来说了。

lines.en: : Two contests later tonight, everything else tomorrow, and a brand new pillow-fight tradition in the second floor’s room starting at midnight. Underwear only and no boys allowed.
lines.zh: : 今晚两场比赛,其余的都安排在明天,还有一项全新的枕头大战传统,午夜在二楼的房间开始。只穿内衣,男生免进。

lines.en: scene beachwarshello8
: Oh, great. Now I have to find somewhere else to sleep. That always goes really well for me.
lines.zh: : 哦,太好了。那我得另找地方睡了。这种事对我来说一向都特别顺利。

lines.en: : On the bright side, looks like me and you probably won’t have to do stuff until tomorrow! Can’t imagine Makoto’s gonna let me use a hammer in the dark.
lines.zh: : 往好处想,看来我和你的活儿大概要到明天才用干!我很难想象 Makoto 会让我在黑灯瞎火里抡锤子。

lines.en: scene beachwarshello9
: You’re really still going to try? Even though you know I’m going to beat you?
lines.zh: : 你还真打算试?哪怕你知道我会赢你?

lines.en: : Yeah. Ain’t no harm in competin’ just because you know somebody else has got the upper hand. There are tons of underdog stories in sports. Maybe I’ll make history tomorrow or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 是啊。明明知道别人占上风还去比,又没坏处。体育界一大堆逆袭的故事呢。说不定我明天就创造历史了什么的?

lines.en: : Woodworking and construction aren’t really sports, though. And while they’re also not as difficult as most people make them out to be, they’re not really a thing you can just pick up on right away.
lines.zh: : 木工和建筑可算不上体育。而且虽然它们也没大多数人说的那么难,但也不是你一上手就能会的东西。

lines.en: : Idunno. Lotta people say the same thing about soccer but I picked up on {i}that{/i} right away.
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊。好多人也这么评价足球,可我{i}一下就上手{/i}了。

lines.en: : Well, good luck kicking a raft together, I guess.
lines.zh: : 行吧,那祝你能把一只木筏踢出来。

lines.en: scene beachwarshello10
: Is that actually an option?
lines.zh: : 那真是个选项吗?

lines.en: : What? No. That was...
lines.zh: : 什么?不是。那是……

lines.en: : Have you ever heard of a “joke” before? Because that was one of those.
lines.zh: : 你以前有没有听说过『玩笑』这种东西?因为刚才那就是一个。

lines.en: : I don’t get it. Ain’t jokes supposed to be, like...funny?
lines.zh: : 我不懂。玩笑不是应该……挺好笑的吗?

lines.en: scene beachwarshello11
: Are you mocking me right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在嘲笑我吗?

lines.en: : Are you mocking {i}me{/i} right now? Cause it kinda sounded like you were, Io.
lines.zh: : 你现在是在嘲笑{i}我{/i}吗?因为听起来有点像哦,Io。

lines.en: : I know I might not be the brightest tool in the shed, but even I get offended when people don’t take me seriously in contests.
lines.zh: : 我知道我可能不是工具棚里最亮的那件工具,但就算是我,别人在比赛上不把我当回事,我也会生气。

lines.en: : You know it’s the {i}sharpest{/i} tool in the shed, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道原话是『{i}最锋利{/i}的那件工具』吧?

lines.en: scene beachwarshello12
: Like I said, I ain’t the sharpest crayon in the box! Just stop underestimatin’ me before we’ve even started.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的,我可能不是盒子里最尖的那支蜡笔!只求你别在还没开始之前就小看我。

lines.en: : That’s not really what I’m trying to do. I mean, it {i}is{/i} kind of what I’m doing, yeah...but that’s only because I don’t get the rationale behind trying something you pretty much know you’re going to fail at.
lines.zh: : 我其实也不是那个意思。我是说,{i}确实{/i}有点那个意思,嗯……但那只是因为我不明白,为什么明知道自己基本会失败还要去试。

lines.en: scene beachwarshello13
: Well, I think it’s like...expectin’ to fail is the problem in the first place.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我觉得……问题恰恰就出在『预期自己会失败』上。

lines.en: : I think anybody’s capable of anything so long as they try their hardest. So there ain’t no challenge I’d back away from before I even give it an attempt, you know?
lines.zh: : 我觉得只要拼尽全力,任何人都能做成任何事。所以没有什么挑战是我在尝试之前就会退缩的,你懂吧?

lines.en: : Wow. People without extreme social anxiety sure have an interesting way of looking at things.
lines.zh: : 哇。没有严重社交焦虑的人看事情的角度可真有意思。

lines.en: : That was a nice motivational speech and all, but I’ll probably just keep avoiding all of the things I know I suck at. You do you, though.
lines.zh: : 这番励志演讲挺不错的,不过我大概还是会继续躲开所有我知道自己不擅长的事。你尽管去吧。

lines.en: scene beachwarshello14
: I will! And don’t even think of takin’ it easy on me tomorrow cause I can tell when somebody ain’t givin’ it their all.
lines.zh: : 我会的!还有,明天别想对我放水,因为谁没全力以赴我看得出来。

lines.en: : Okay, but...again. You have absolutely no chance and I wouldn’t hold it against you if you gave up now and saved yourself the splinters.
lines.zh: : 好吧,不过……再说一遍。你一点机会都没有,要是你现在放弃、省得扎一手的刺,我不会因此看不起你。

lines.en: : Splinter was my favorite ninja turtle. I got this.
lines.zh: : Splinter 是我最喜欢的忍者神龟。我扛得住。

lines.en: : Splinter was a rat.
lines.zh: : Splinter 是只老鼠。

lines.en: scene black
: What? Then who was the one with the staff?
lines.zh: : 什么?那拿棍子的是谁?

lines.en: : Donatello. And don’t ask me why I know this.
lines.zh: : Donatello。别问我为什么知道这个。

lines.en: : Why do you know this?
lines.zh: : 你为什么知道这个?

lines.en: : Does literally anything anyone says to you register or do you just live in your own world all the time?
lines.zh: : 别人对你说的任何话到底有没有一句进脑子,还是你一直活在自己的世界里?

lines.en: : You want pizza, Io? Because I kinda want pizza now.
lines.zh: : 你想吃披萨吗,Io?因为我现在有点想吃披萨了。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}This is a whole new level of “hard to talk to” that even I’m struggling to properly grasp.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}这已经是一种全新层次的『难以沟通』了,连我都很难准确把握。

lines.en: scene beachwarshello15
: Anxious about your contest at all? Still planning on using the same strategy you told me about last night?
lines.zh: : 对你的比赛紧张吗?还打算用你昨晚跟我说的那套策略?

lines.en: : You mean nervously throwing a bunch of ingredients together and hoping that whatever comes out on the other side is edible? Yeah. After a lot of thought, I think that’s how I’m gonna handle things.
lines.zh: : 你是说紧张地把一堆食材胡乱搅在一起,然后祈祷最后端出来的东西还能吃?是啊。想了很久之后,我觉得就这么办。

lines.en: : How about you, though? Don’t you feel a little weird coming up with a confession speech when you’re already in a relationship?
lines.zh: : 那你呢?你都已经有对象了,还要写什么告白词,不觉得有点怪吗?

lines.en: scene beachwarshello16
: I mean...it’s just writing at the end of the day. People write all sorts of things all the time and it doesn’t mean they actually {i}feel{/i} them, you know?
lines.zh: : 那个……归根到底只是写作而已。人随时都会写各种各样的东西,也不代表他们真的有那种{i}感觉{/i},你懂吧?

lines.en: : It’s just kind of like...tapping into somebody {i}else’s{/i} feelings...or something. It’s not really a big deal.
lines.zh: : 就像……借用{i}别人{/i}的感情……之类的。真不是什么大事。

lines.en: : I wish I could think of it that way. I’ve always...found separating myself from writing to be kind of hard.
lines.zh: : 我真希望能那样想。我一直……觉得把写作和自己剥离挺难的。

lines.en: : Even with {i}my{/i} contest, I’m having a hard time figuring out how I’m going to tackle things. And it definitely doesn’t help that I’ll be competing with {i}Nodoka{/i} of all people.
lines.zh: : 就连{i}这{/i}场比赛,我都很头疼该怎么下手。而偏偏要与 {i}Nodoka{/i} 竞争,这更是雪上加霜。

lines.en: : Don’t sell yourself short, Futaba. You’re extremely talented and {i}I{/i} am extremely unmotivated right now. In my current state, you have a real shot at beating me.
lines.zh: : 别小看自己,Futaba。你非常有才华,而{i}我{/i}眼下极度缺乏动力。以我现在的状态,你真有机会赢我。

lines.en: scene beachwarshello17
: Well, at least you’re honest enough to admit that I couldn’t beat you under {i}normal{/i} circumstances.
lines.zh: : 嗯,至少你够诚实,承认了在{i}正常{/i}情况下我赢不了你。

lines.en: : I kind of hope you do, though. Nodoka needs somebody to humble her and it seems like everyone else is just food for her ego most of the time.
lines.zh: : 不过我还真希望你能赢。Nodoka 需要有人挫挫她的锐气,而其他人大多数时候似乎只是在喂饱她的自我。

lines.en: : Did you hear that, Futaba? Otoha thinks I’m going to {i}eat{/i} you.
lines.zh: : 听到了吗,Futaba?Otoha 说我要{i}吃{/i}了你。

lines.en: : I think you’d eat literally anyone if presented the opportunity. Both sexually and {i}not{/i} sexually. And Futaba is definitely no exception to that based on how close you are to her right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得只要有机会,你谁都吃得下。无论是性意义上的还是非性意义上的。而你现在跟她贴得这么近,Futaba 绝对{i}不{/i}例外。

lines.en: : You...{i}are{/i} a little close, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 你……{i}确实{/i}贴得有点近,Nodoka。

lines.en: : I know. Isn’t it great?
lines.zh: : 我知道。很棒吧?

lines.en: scene beachwarshello18
: It...can’t be helped, I suppose...
lines.zh: : 这……也是没办法吧,我想……

lines.en: : Wow. You really just let her do whatever she wants with you, huh?
lines.zh: : 哇。你还真是由着她对你为所欲为啊?

lines.en: : Oh, Rin. If that were true, do you {i}really{/i} think our clothes would be on right now?
lines.zh: : 哦,Rin。要是{i}真{/i}那样,你觉得我们现在的衣服还会在身上吗?

lines.en: : In a public space? I sure hope so.
lines.zh: : 在公共场合?我希望还在。

lines.en: : She’s been like this forever, Rin. There’s no point in trying to change her this late in life.
lines.zh: : 她一直都这样,Rin。都这么久了,想改也改不掉了。

lines.en: : I mean...as long as {i}you’re{/i} okay with it, that’s cool. She’s just a different level of clingy with you that makes me feel like there’s more to it than just-
lines.zh: : 我是说……只要{i}你{/i}没问题就行。只是她对你黏人的程度完全是另一个级别,让我觉得背后还有别的原因-

lines.en: : You’re just jealous because Otoha doesn’t hold you the way I hold Futaba.

lines.en: : I know it’s probably hard finding out that the guy you like is dating somebody else...but if you didn’t hold a special place in Sensei’s heart, he wouldn’t have suggested you. So you can be happy about that.
lines.zh: : 我知道,发现自己喜欢的男生在跟别人交往,可能很难接受……但如果你在 Sensei 心里没有特殊的位置,他就不会提议找你了。所以你可以为此高兴一点。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’m over the moon.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我高兴坏了。

lines.en: : Ayane, I know this is, like...a {i}really{/i} weird thing to ask. And I also know that you’ve probably never done {i}anything{/i} sexual before, so this is all coming out of left field and...probably scary.
lines.zh: : Ayane,我知道这……是个{i}很{/i}奇怪的请求。我也知道你大概从来没做过{i}任何{/i}性方面的事,所以这一切听起来很突然,而且……大概挺吓人的。

lines.en: : But if you’re okay with it, I promise to do everything I can to make you comfortable. And it might be the only chance you get to be with Sensei at this rate since he and I are really serious.
lines.zh: : 但如果你愿意,我保证会尽我所能让你舒服。而且照这个势头下去,这说不定是你唯一一次能和 Sensei 在一起的机会,毕竟我和他是认真的。

lines.en: scene beachwarshello53

lines.en: : Like...we’re totally committed to each other.

lines.en: : Do you want to start a family with him?
lines.zh: : 你想和他组建家庭吗?

lines.en: : Do you want to have his kids?
lines.zh: : 你想给他生孩子吗?

lines.en: : Do you even know the first thing about him?
lines.zh: : 你对他到底了解多少?

lines.en: : Ayane, I’m not looking to have an in-depth conversation about the specifics of my relationship. I’m just trying to do something nice for my boyfriend and was wondering if you’d be interested. That’s all.
lines.zh: : Ayane,我不是想深入讨论我这段关系的细节。我只是想为我男朋友做点好事,然后想知道你有没有兴趣。就这样。

lines.en: : Oh, I’m interested. I’m {i}very{/i} interested.
lines.zh: : 哦,我有兴趣。我{i}非常{/i}有兴趣。

lines.en: scene beachwarshello54
: You...You {i}are?...{/i}

lines.zh: : 是的。我等不及要体验这也许是我此生唯一一次能『亲近』Sensei 的机会了。我相信那一定会非常……非常……非常……{i}非常{/i}特别。

lines.en: : You’re sure? Like...100%% sure?...

lines.en: : And you’re not just fucking with me, right? Because if you’re fucking with me-

lines.en: : Y...Yeah. I...I bet you are...Hahah...

lines.zh: : 那个,呃……哈哈……我想我就……等我想清楚了……再打电话给你……

lines.en: : Sounds good, Chika. I’ll be looking forward to sharing the man I love with you. I’m sure it’ll be a blast.
lines.zh: : 听起来不错,Chika。我会很期待和你分享我爱的那个男人的。我相信一定会很尽兴。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...
